fieldValues.title: RFC-004 Change H: Add JSON Schema projection package
fieldValues.proposed_change: Add `com.semanticops.spec/spec-authoring-json-schema` as a target projection package with exact mapping rules for rendering schema definitions and members into JSON Schema.
fieldValues.rationale: JSON Schema is the first exact projection, but it does not own the semantic source.
